verdict.rationale: Fathom documents an official MCP server that any MCP-compatible tool can connect to by server URL and then authenticate. It is also an official connector in Claude, and Claude Code can add it with a single command, so no glue code is needed. Missing for 10: the docs never list which MCP tools are exposed (search, transcripts, action items), never explicitly name OAuth as the MCP auth method (only 'authenticate'), and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
